cards.ex: Kids soak up knowledge like sponges; it's amazing to watch them learn.
cards.exUz: Bolalar bilimni gubka kabi o'zlashtiradilar; ularning o'rganishini kuzatish hayratlanarli.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p bilimni oson va tez qabul qilish, o'zlashtirish.

cards.ex: The teacher's pedagogical approach really helped the struggling students.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchining pedagogik yondashuvi qiynalayotgan o'quvchilarga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'lim berish usuli yoki metodikasi.

cards.ex: Rote learning isn't as effective as understanding the underlying concepts.
cards.exUz: Yodlash asosiy tushunchalarni tushunish kabi samarali emas.
cards.uzDef: Ma'nosini tushunmasdan mexanik tarzda yodlash.

cards.ex: To solve this problem, we need to think outside the box.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari o'ylashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Narsalarga yangicha va ijodiy nuqtai nazardan qarash.

cards.ex: Lifelong learning is essential in today's rapidly changing world.
cards.exUz: Bugungi tez o'zgaruvchan dunyoda umrbod ta'lim juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Hayot davomida o'rganish va rivojlanish.

cards.ex: Many students grapple with complex mathematical concepts.
cards.exUz: Ko'p talabalar murakkab matematik tushunchalar bilan kurashadilar.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin masala yoki muammo bilan kurashish.

cards.ex: There's definitely a learning curve when you start using this software.
cards.exUz: Bu dasturdan foydalanishni boshlaganingizda, albatta, o'rganish jarayoni bor.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani o'rganish jarayonidagi qiyinchilik darajasi.

cards.ex: He picked up a skill in coding during his summer internship.
cards.exUz: U yozgi amaliyot davrida kodlash bo'yicha mahorat egalladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ko'nikmani o'rganish yoki o'zlashtirish.

cards.ex: The company has a vast knowledge base on renewable energy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning qayta tiklanadigan energiya bo'yicha katta bilimlar bazasi mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan sohada to'plangan bilimlar majmui.

cards.ex: Early childhood education lays the foundation for future academic success.
cards.exUz: Bolalikdagi ta'lim kelajakdagi akademik muvaffaqiyat uchun zamin yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi o'rganishlar uchun zamin yaratish.

cards.ex: The teacher always goes the extra mile to help her students succeed.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi har doim o'quvchilarining muvaffaqiyatiga erishishiga yordam berish uchun qo'shimcha harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Talab qilinganidan ko'ra ko'proq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's currently pursuing undergraduate studies in engineering.
cards.exUz: U hozirda muhandislik bo'yicha bakalavriatda o'qiyapti.
cards.uzDef: Universitetda bakalavr darajasini olish uchun o'qish.

cards.ex: After graduating, he plans to pursue postgraduate studies abroad.
cards.exUz: O'qishni tugatgandan so'ng, u chet elda magistratura bosqichida o'qishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Universitetda magistr yoki doktorlik darajasini olish uchun o'qish.

cards.ex: Distance learning has become increasingly popular in recent years.
cards.exUz: Masofaviy ta'lim so'nggi yillarda tobora ommalashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali olib boriladigan ta'lim shakli.

cards.ex: I'm taking an online course to improve my data analysis skills.
cards.exUz: Men ma'lumotlarni tahlil qilish ko'nikmalarimni oshirish uchun onlayn kurs o'qiyapman.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali o'tiladigan o'quv kursi.

cards.ex: She's a fast learner and quickly masters new software programs.
cards.exUz: U tez o'rganuvchi va tezda yangi dasturiy ta'minot dasturlarini o'zlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsalarni tez va oson o'rganadigan odam.

cards.ex: Traveling is a great way to gain knowledge about different cultures.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qilish turli madaniyatlar haqida bilim orttirishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ma'lumotlarni o'rganish va tushunish orqali bilimga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Universities aim to teach students to think critically and solve problems.
cards.exUz: Universitetlar talabalarga tanqidiy fikrlashni va muammolarni hal qilishni o'rgatishga intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni tahlil qilib, asoslangan xulosalar chiqarish.

cards.ex: His educational background includes a master's degree in economics.
cards.exUz: Uning ma'lumotiga iqtisodiyot bo'yicha magistrlik darajasi kiradi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning olgan ta'limi va malakasi.

cards.ex: It's important to stay on top of current research in your field.
cards.exUz: O'z sohangizdagi hozirgi tadqiqotlardan doimo xabardor bo'lib turish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan doimiy ravishda xabardor bo'lib turish.

cards.ex: Traveling helps you open your mind to different cultures and perspectives.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qilish turli madaniyatlar va nuqtai nazarlarga ongingizni ochishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi g'oyalar va nuqtai nazarlarga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: She has a thirst for knowledge and is always eager to learn new things.
cards.exUz: Uning bilimga chanqoqligi bor va u har doim yangi narsalarni o'rganishga intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsalarni o'rganishga kuchli xohish.

cards.ex: His academic performance has improved significantly this semester.
cards.exUz: Uning akademik ko'rsatkichi bu semestrda sezilarli darajada yaxshilandi.
cards.uzDef: O'quvchining o'qishdagi muvaffaqiyat darajasi.

cards.ex: There are different schools of thought on how to best teach mathematics.
cards.exUz: Matematikani eng yaxshi o'qitish usuli bo'yicha turli fikr maktablari mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan mavzu bo'yicha umumiy qarashlarga ega bo'lgan odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: Education can help level the playing field for disadvantaged students.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim imkoniyati cheklangan o'quvchilar uchun teng sharoit yaratishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar yaratish.

cards.ex: Higher education is becoming increasingly important for career success.
cards.exUz: Oliy ta'lim karyera muvaffaqiyati uchun tobora muhim ahamiyat kasb etmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Universitet yoki kollejda olinadigan ta'lim.

cards.ex: The school aims to produce well-rounded students who are ready for the world.
cards.exUz: Maktab dunyoga tayyor bo'lgan har tomonlama rivojlangan o'quvchilarni yetishtirishni maqsad qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Turli sohalarda bilimga ega bo'lish, ko'p qirrali bo'lish.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get to grips with the new software.
cards.exUz: Yangi dasturni tushunish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qiyin narsani tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He learned the hard way that you can't trust everyone.
cards.exUz: U hamma odamlarga ishonib bo'lmasligini qiyin yo'l bilan o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolardan saboq olib o'rganish.

cards.ex: The school provides a supportive learning environment for all students.
cards.exUz: Maktab barcha talabalar uchun qulay ta'lim muhitini yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: O'rganish uchun qulay sharoit.
